name: Waveshare ESP32-C6-Zero
description: Castellated 23.5 x 18 mm ESP32-C6FH8 board (8 MB in-package flash) with USB-C and WS2812 LED for about $5: Wi-Fi 6, BLE 5 and Thread/Zigbee in the smallest package.
notes: Pin order with USB-C at the top: left 5V, GND, 3V3(out), GP0-GP5; right TX, RX, GP14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22; GP6-9, 12, 13, 23 on underside pads. No mechanical drawing, so no header data.
WS2812 on GPIO8 and BOOT button on GPIO9 (strapping pins). Native USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO12/13 only, no UART bridge.
Sold without headers; a version with headers soldered costs about $1 more.
